data.ReviewText: I called this morning to get a quote and had my garage cleared out by 1 this afternoon. Justin was very friendly and did a fantastic job. I highly recommend him.

I had a small, but very difficult furniture moving job in my house. I normally do things myself, but this was far beyond my ability. Bennett's was quick to respond, they communicated clearly, and their pricing was fair. Their arrival was prompt, and they made quick work of my moving job. I recommend them to my friends, and would definitely hire them again.
On time, polite, professional, very careful. Did a great job very pleased, Thanks!
Showed up with 3 guys ready to work, Unloaded two 26' Uhauls and a 6x12 trailer in less than 4 hours. Haul a couple tons of stuff up stairs.
So helpful I couldn't ask for more!
They were on time and did a wonderful job! Very professional and respectful.

Hardworking and dependable, I would easily hire them again. On one of the hottest days of the year these guys spent eight hours moving everything out of my house and my fiancee's house to our new place. They were very professional and treated all our stuff delicately. These guys earned every single one of these five stars.

This team was fast, professional, and efficient. They were able to accomplish moving me into my apartment with three narrow doors and two half steps. My neighbor commented that every other moving company was unable to get a 3 seat couch in my apartment complex. They did it with such ease. They were in and out in 20 minutes.

You can rely on Chase and his team to get the job done. I certainly will use them in the future.
Very professional & productive would recommend to anyone!

I had a particularly challenging move and Bennett Moving was amazing in handling all the obstacles.  Professional, timely and hardworking.  Would definitely recommend!  Will use again in our future moves!!  Cindy & JoAnne

Highly recommend this moving service! Very professional, did an absolute great job, very prompt and on time, went of their way to accommodate our time frame! Quick and efficient! Hire Bennett for all your moving needs!!
Great service, helped move out of an apartment into a house. Listen to them when they quote frame, they were correct.
Group was professional and took good care of items while moving
Super reliable, good communication, kind, respectful, efficient. They’re also reasonably priced - definitely recommend these guys!
Very professional employees, handled all my furnished with care. Very nice prices service.
